corridor: Tampines to Bugis; alternative through Paya Lebar CC9 and Promenade DT15

railGeometry.validation: Directional track-way joins checked; 16 segments, 19 directional stop positions. Raw inputs and extraction audit in engineering return.

walkingLimit: Interchange topology verified by operator sources. Map strokes are indicative connections between line anchors, not surveyed indoor pedestrian geometry. Follow signs; no step-free guarantee or measured walking distance claim.

timing.note: Scenario assumptions, not timetable or live predictions. Only the 2-minute Promenade–Bugis ride corroborated by operator chart.

events: Authored fixtures; never official service notices. Planned westbound closure or unplanned 22-minute delay Paya Lebar–Aljunied between 08:00 and 10:00 on selected replay date.

liveAdapter.scope: 19 line-specific station codes on the existing corridor. Actual source intervals and upstream retrieval timestamps remain separate. Live information is advisory only; routing and preferences remain replay.
liveAdapter.attribution: LTA DataMall, TrainServiceAlerts and Station Crowd Density Real Time
liveAdapter.freshness: Only valid intervals with start <= upstream retrieval <= now < end are eligible for a current label. Re-fetch does not renew old intervals. Offline and failed-source reports are explicitly last-known.

boarding: Unavailable: no approaching-train carriage observation, validated orientation or door mapping supplied.
offline: Only same-origin app shell, route geometry and saved guidance cached. No OSM raster prefetch or service-worker tile cache.
